purpose: Everything a future delta pass needs to run the detector against a fresh fetch, without storing 56.2 MB of raw HTML. Every value is a truncated SHA-256 (16 hex chars, 64 bits) of one element of the set the detector diffs. Set membership is all the delta needs: a flag fires when the new set has a member the old set lacks, and hashing both sides preserves that exactly. The evidence STRING is deliberately not recoverable — this file supports a fire/no-fire rate, not an alert message.

sets.text_lines: non-blank lines of extracted text -> the text-diff checks

verification.method: Extracted text was reconstructed offline from the raw HTML captured on 2026-07-29 using the same trafilatura path as fetcher.fetch_url, then hashed and compared against the content_hash already in MANIFEST.json. A match proves the reconstruction is byte-exact, so the line hashes below describe the text the tool actually ingested on the day.
